subject: Moving, but NOT Closing down!
author: ZombieTron
body:
To quash any rumours to the contrary, I just want to reassure all you BurnoutAholics that the site will continue even after we move to Norway.

We have no plans to close the site at all, and we will still be running the site as we always have done.

Thank you all for your continued support, it means a lot to us!

ZombieTron 🙂
